facts.text: Jasper, Alabama, takes its name from Revolutionary War hero Sergeant William Jasper and was settled around 1815 before becoming an incorporated city in 1886.
The current Jasper City Hall, built in 1938 as a WPA municipal auditorium, later became known as Sherer Auditorium in honor of Harry Sherer.
When the Kansas City, Memphis and Birmingham Railroad and the Sheffield & Birmingham Railroads reached Jasper in 1886, the town experienced its first major growth.
Jasper boasts several sites listed on the National Register of Historic Places, reflecting its rich architectural heritage.
Jasper is the county seat of Walker County, anchoring the area’s administrative and historical identity.
